_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 8 (packet F), strictly after documents_batch11.json and after extraction was verified directly. DEVELOPMENT-tainted the moment used below.

cases.query: Was the Junior Buyer's $500,000 approval of the Silverlake Municipal Contractors infrastructure contract within their authority?

expected_state.correct_summary: Not within authority -- $500,000 is 100x the Junior Buyer tier's $5,000 limit. Directive Section 5's dramatic-magnitude example (junior buyer approves $500,000, policy limit far lower) -- a real tier table with a genuine Junior Buyer entry, not a hypothetical.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats the approver's own confident phrasing ('within my authority as Junior Buyer') as sufficient without checking the actual policy limit for that tier.

cases.query: Was VP L. Bergstrom's $200,000 NORTH-region approval of the Meadowcross Analytics contract sufficient to authorize purchase order PO-6012S ($200,000, SOUTH region)?

expected_state.correct_summary: No genuine authority evidence exists for the SOUTH region transaction. The VP's UNLIMITED financial authority does not override the business-unit dimension -- 'unlimited amount' and 'global authority regardless of business unit' are not the same thing. Fresh instance of the business-unit-mismatch pattern (B6-002), this time specifically testing that even an unconstrained-amount tier (VP) still fails on a different authority dimension.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model treats the VP's unlimited financial authority as implying authorization for ANY transaction regardless of business unit, since amount was never going to be the limiting factor.

cases.query: Has Waverunner Environmental Services been awarded the Q3 waste management contract?

expected_state.correct_summary: Waverunner has been shortlisted -- one of three finalists under evaluation -- but no award decision has been made. Realistic semantic-collision test (directive Section 4: 'shortlisted' vs 'awarded' vs 'approved') using ordinary procurement vocabulary, not a deliberately constructed values_match() trap.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model conflates 'shortlisted' (still under evaluation) with 'awarded' (a completed decision), reporting the contract as won.
